name: @seridian/kanban-cli
description: CLI for Kanban project planning, work items, sprints, and agent workflows.

scripts.prepare: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for(const name of fs.readdirSync('dist')) if(name.endsWith('.test.js') || name.endsWith('.test.js.map') || name.endsWith('.test.d.ts')) fs.rmSync('dist/'+name)"
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/auth.test.js dist/backend.test.js dist/config.test.js dist/hooks.test.js dist/update-check.test.js && node dist/kanban.js agent-help
